name: showcase-astra-led-panel
description: Inverts the usual shape: Codex Astra conducts and the Claude and Grok agents are the workers. Worth running because the codex adapter's coordinator_args are real — a coordinates_only codex conductor is launched with `--sandbox read-only`, and because coordinator_args are appended AFTER auto_approve_args, that read-only wins on last-flag semantics even if auto-approval was requested. The containment is visible in the dry-run argv before anything starts.

question.description: The question the panel must answer

agents.instructions: You conduct and you are read-only by construction — the sandbox flag your adapter passes makes that a property of the process, not a promise. Put the same question to both analysts, wait for both, and then do the one thing only you can do: decide which answer survives contact with the other. Where they agree, say so briefly. Where they differ, do not split the difference — work out which is actually right and say why the other went wrong.
